summary: Government-fixed maximum migration cost (সরকার নির্ধারিত অভিবাসন ব্যয়). Saudi Arabia/Singapore figures could not be traced to an official document online.

countries.includes: Maximum cost borne by the worker (Bangladesh-side costs only): passport, medical test registration, welfare fee, insurance, smart card fee, pre-departure fee, clothing, recruiting agent's service charge and misc. Under the 19 Dec 2021 MoU the Malaysian employer bears: security deposit, processing fees, visit pass, insurance (EIS/SPIKPA), medical exam in Malaysia, immigration security clearance, biomedical, visa processing, visa, first-entry and exit air tickets, attestation fee by BD High Commission, MRA service charge, COVID tests, quarantine.
